body.statement: For \((p^{\mathrm G},s^{\mathrm G})\), does the induced known-margin relevant-IV fiber pass exact compatibility and relevance, and is \(\tau\) rigid on that fiber? Using the GEUVADIS audit handle, return either the exact atlas stratum and PN/PS formula with transition-robust uncertainty, or two legal full SCMs with identical \((p^{\mathrm G},m^{\mathrm G})\) and different targets; report model incompatibility separately from nonidentification.
body.justification: The public case study is a high-value falsification target because its bootstrap estimates reach both logical boundaries.
body.gap: The published application assumes the graph and regular conditions but does not certify compatibility, rank/support stratum, or transition-robust coverage.
body.consumer: Researchers interpreting SWAP70-to-SBF2-AS1 attribution receive either a defensible causal number or an explicit nonidentification certificate.

obligation.what_is_open: The exact compatibility, relevance, rigidity, and uncertainty classification of the named GEUVADIS table.
obligation.obstruction: The frozen primitives do not contain the numerical count table or binarization thresholds defining the actual observable coordinates, and the required global mixed-support classifier is unfinished.  The symbolic description alone cannot distinguish incompatibility from nonidentification.
obligation.attempted: The known-selection normalization and the exact response-level IV constraints to be imposed were derived.
obligation.partial_result:
The imposed positive selection probabilities determine the application margin, without approximation, by
\[
m_e^{\mathrm G}
=\frac{r_e^{\mathrm G}/s_e^{\mathrm G}}{\sum_f r_f^{\mathrm G}/s_f^{\mathrm G}}.
\]
Thus any eventual audit must intersect the design-B residual equations with this fixed margin and must test relevance separately.  The frozen core does not supply the numerical released count table or the binarization thresholds needed to determine \(p^{\mathrm G}\), and the exhaustive mixed-support compiler needed to classify its exact fiber is not yet proved.  No compatibility, rigidity, or legal-twin conclusion for the named data can therefore be derived from the supplied primitives.
